issue_context.title: Annotate unsupported APIs in System.Diagnostics.Process
issue_context.body:
As part of https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/issues/47228 running an analyzer to detect APIs throwing PNSE but have not being annotated with the any of `Obsolete, SupportedOSPlatform, UnsupportedOSPlatform` attributes, we need to annotate them so that developers get warnings when they use them unexpectedly

API | Finding | Reachable platforms | Comment | Suggestion | Location
-- | -- | -- | -- | -- | --
'Process.ProcessorAffinityCore' |  unconditionally throws PNSE | reachable on FreeBSD, OSX, iOS, tvOS, | private API called from public   ProcessorAffinity | Add Unsupported   for FreeBSD, OSX, iOS, tvOS | Process.BSD.cs(47,17)
'ProcessManager.GetMainWindowHandle(int)'  | unconditionally throws PNSE | reachable on Linux, OSX, iOS,   tvOS, FreeBSD | internal API not referenced within the   type | Probably dead code,   else annotate accordingly | ProcessManager.Unix.cs(77,13)
'ProcessThread.StartTime.get'  | unconditionally throws PNSE | reachable on FreeBSD, OSX, iOS, tvOS | public API | Add Unsupported for  FreeBSD, OSX, iOS, tvOS | ProcessThread.OSX.cs(31,19)
'ProcessThread.PriorityLevelCore.get' |  unconditionally throws PNSE | reachable on OSX, iOS, tvOS | Called from public PriorityLevel | Add Unsupported for   OSX, iOS, tvOS | ProcessThread.OSX.cs(18,19)

cc @jeffhandley @terrajobst @GrabYourPitchforks
